name: Naviva, A Four Seasons Resort
address: Lote H-2, Carretera Federal 200, Km 19.5, 63734 Punta de Mita, Nayarit, Mexico
tagline: Fifteen tented bungalows for adults on a forested Pacific shore.
description:
Naviva, a Four Seasons Resort, is an adults-only resort of 15 tented bungalows on the Pacific coast of Mexico. The bungalows stand on 48 forested acres, about 19.5 hectares, between jungle and the shoreline at the northern tip of Bahía de Banderas. A stretch of beach 175 metres long, about 191 yards, is reserved for guests. The resort shares its private peninsula with Four Seasons Resort Punta Mita. The address is Lote H-2, Carretera Federal 200, kilometre 19.5, 63734 Punta de Mita, Nayarit.

The nightly rate includes all dining and beverages, a 90-minute spa journey and select experiences. Meals at the neighbouring Four Seasons Resort Punta Mita are included as well. In-bungalow dining is available around the clock.

An Ocean-View Bungalow measures 116 square metres, or 1,259 square feet, of indoor-outdoor space, with one king bed, a private plunge pool, and room for 2 adults. An Ocean-View Grand Bungalow measures 149 to 160 square metres, or 1,604 to 1,722 square feet, also for 2 adults, with a plunge pool and an extended deck with a firepit. Naviva Unplugged performances are limited to an audience of never more than 30 in-house guests.

Cocina Copal cooks over an open fire, using the sea catch and seasonal produce. Selva Pool serves light food and drinks in the forest. Garden Grotto looks toward the Pacific, and a picnic can be set on a quiet beach. The spa works from two pods, one toward sunrise and one toward sunset, and from a House of Heat temazcal. The journey included in the rate lasts 90 minutes. Temazcal sessions last 150 minutes, as do several of the rituals. Yoga is held on the cliff at Risco Terrace, and an outdoor gym uses trees and boulders. Self-guided hiking and running trails cross the property.

The Road to Raicilla leaves by boat across the bay for Cabo Corrientes, or by land for San Sebastián del Oeste, for tastings at local raicilla tabernas. Puerto Vallarta International Airport, PVR, is 20 kilometres, or 12.5 miles, and a 45-minute drive.
